hints.title: Cycle Definition in Grid
hints.text: A cycle consists of a path of length at least 4 where adjacent cells share the same letter and you revisit a previously seen cell that is not the immediate parent.

hints.title: DFS with Parent Tracking
hints.text: Run depth-first search for each unvisited cell. Pass the previous cell coordinates (pr, pc) to prevent trivial two-step back-and-forth returns.

hints.title: Cycle Detection Criterion
hints.text: If you encounter an adjacent neighbor with the same character that is already marked visited and differs from (pr, pc), a cycle exists.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-running traversals without global visited tracking leads to exponential paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Each grid cell is visited at most once, bounding time and recursion depth to O(R * C).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate passes parent cell coordinates to distinguish between immediate backtracking and a genuine cycle of length >= 4.
